Strategy: Two-room bonus: add a large bonus when a bin still fits two more items of the same size after this placement, otherwise score by tightest fit; this steers items into bins that stay highly reusable instead of nearly closing a bin. It can fail when it systematically avoids closing bins, leaving many half-open bins.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [(-(r - item) + (500.0 if r >= 3 * item else 0.0)) for r in bins]
```
